set: diagnose development set, card 007 (40 runs, 533 responses)
status: DEVELOPMENT set, not held-out: use it to develop and tune diagnose questions or thresholds; the held-out evaluation set stays labels/labels.jsonl.
adjudicator: Claude Opus 5.5 (the S6b mining subagent) standing in for a human reviewer; no human labelled this set.
scope: every response whose rule phase is explore (329), plus the three Jev-flagged responses with another rule phase. Responses in other rule phases are not diagnose by the schema's precedence and are not listed. All 40 runs are complete for diagnose under the conventions below (complete = true).
review: the 10 runs of tasks 001, 022, 032, 057, 061 were read response by response; in the other 30 runs every explore response with text was read, and every explore response without text was judged from the latest earlier text (the carry rule).
conventions: diagnose needs a hypothesis stated in the agent's text: specific code (function, branch, variable, recent change) named as the suspected cause of the reported failure. Locating language ('find where X', 'understand how Y works', 'find the tests') is not a hypothesis.
the response's calls must read, search, or print that code (or code read to confirm it). Searches that only find a definition are locating (explore), as in the held-out adjudication.
carry: a response without text inherits the latest earlier text's hypothesis only while every response in between pursued or tested the same suspect.
after an edit that acts on the hypothesis, re-reading the edited code with no new hypothesis is post-edit review (explore).
a reproduce, verify, edit, or finish call outranks diagnose (schema precedence).

strength: clear = the response's own text asserts the suspect as the likely or actual cause and its calls read it; borderline = hedged ('might', 'to see if'), carried, or the calls only partly pursue the suspect.
whether the hypothesis was right does not matter.
fields: run, task_id, response, rule_phase, jev_phase, jev_diagnose_probability, jev_flagged (probability >= 0.3 or Jev's choice diagnose), adjudicated_phase, diagnose_strength (clear|borderline|null), hypothesis_response, review (read in full|text and carry screen), complete, note
